note: GFP recreation area on the west arm of Angostura Reservoir, 6 miles south of Hot Springs on SD 71 then 5 miles east on Sheps Canyon Road; the newest campground on the reservoir. Two camping areas about 3 km apart: the electric main loop above Sheps Canyon Bay, by the boat ramp, and the non-electric Sheps South row strung along the reservoir shore. Also camping cabins, a three-bedroom group lodge, a separate horse camp (11 sites) and 2 first-come group sites. Hiking and horse trails. Between Oct. 1 and April 30 the showers, flush toilets and water may be shut off; vault toilets stay open. --Claude

All 40 Sheps South sites are nightly reservable non-electric $16 sites. The main loop at the pin (1E-22E) is NOT lakefront: 17E-20E (e.g. 19E 43.32519,-103.44480) are ~50+ m from Sheps Canyon Bay through a continuous tree band, and the bay there shows on the 2022 frame as a ~13-20 m channel - a view at best.
